name: Anterior Inferior Iliac Spine Avulsion Fracture
tags: anterior inferior iliac spine avulsion fracture
definition: Adolescent avulsion fracture of the AIIS caused by forceful contraction of rectus femoris during kicking or sprinting.

investigations.principle: Radiographs are first-line; CT/MRI is selected for displacement or chronic impingement.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when neural, soft-tissue, marrow, vascular, occult injury or other condition-specific assessment requires it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific imaging pathway.

amber: Displaced fractures or symptomatic exostosis may require surgery.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

patientEducation.summary: Adolescent avulsion fracture of the AIIS caused by forceful contraction of rectus femoris during kicking or sprinting.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute/progressive neurological deficit, severe vascular symptoms, infection/systemic illness, major trauma, sphincter change or other listed red flags.
